284805885.description: This collection features four natural mineral and stone pieces, including an amethyst crystal cluster with druzy points on matrix, a natural smoky quartz crystal point/cluster, a rough smoky quartz specimen, and a carved green soapstone figure titled "Where the Forest Go" #9508, signed by artist John Craig Loveing Bear. The carved figure depicts an abstract animal form with mottled green and black veining characteristic of soapstone, featuring a polished finish mounted on a rectangular base with visible tool marks. All pieces display natural mineral characteristics and minor surface wear consistent with age and handling. This vintage collection offers a nice variety for the mineral and art collector.
